title: Teriyaki Pork Bites and Noodles
ingredients: 2 pounds pork chops, cut into bite size pieces
1 teaspoon ginger paste (or grate your own)
2-3 tablespoons cornstarch (depending on desired sauce thickness)
instructions: Add soy sauce, brown sugar, honey, sesame oil, white wine vinegar, ginger paste, garlic, pepper, and cornstarch. Mix until well combined.
Add pork chop bites and toss with the sauce.
When pork chops are done, cook the ramen noodles, strain, and add them in.
Top with chives and sesame seeds if desired.
